name: Exterior Porch Floor Wood Surface Preparation
intent: Wood-specific prep. Mill glaze removal, moisture content test, sand, clean.
doctrine: Wood prep. Mill glaze removal 50 SF/hr (60-80 grit belt/orbital — slow, pending field verification). Sand intensity by QT: QT2 light 100 SF/hr, QT3 standard 70 SF/hr, QT4 full complete 50 SF/hr. MC test mandatory — MC > 15% = stop work. Clean 500 SF/hr low-pressure wash.
